results.title: Biosignal-based co-adaptive user-machine interfaces for motor control
results.snippet: In this article, we review adaptive decoding, user learning, and co-adaptation in user-machine interfaces, primarily brain-computer, myoelectric, and kinematic interfaces, for motor control. We then discuss performance criteria for co-adaptive interfaces and propose a game-theoretic approach to designing user-decoder co-adaptation.
